source_material: Repair this vague prompt: Build the best application and keep improving it forever.
objective: Produce a finite, testable, implementation-ready application-creation prompt.
hard_requirements: Replace infinite evolution with bounded refinement.
Use measurable comparison criteria rather than universal superiority claims.
End at an exact evidence-supported completion state.
constraints: Do not execute the underlying application project.
Do not claim novelty without a defined prior-art search.
non_goals: Publishing, deployment, purchasing, or account creation
